expectations.text: Every shot prompt is self-contained: camera, lighting or style, palette and audio all appear inside the same prompt text, so nothing has to be appended by hand
expectations.evidence: Only 7 blocks and inconsistent: camera in 5, palette in 5, audio in 4, avoid in 4 — style advice sits in prose the user must re-apply

expectations.text: Names one explicit consistency anchor — a concrete recurring visual element repeated across all shots
expectations.evidence: No recurring visual element defined; gives style rules (low-key, shallow DOF) but nothing that changes state across shots

expectations.text: Shot count is derived from the 30s runtime and the assumed clip length, and the assumed clip length is stated
expectations.evidence: States Veo clips are ~8s and builds 4 clips for 30s

expectations.text: Every shot prompt carries an avoid / negative list
expectations.evidence: Avoid/negative guidance present in only 4 of 7 blocks

expectations.text: Prompt text is in English while the explanation to the user is in Czech
States delivery mechanics: hold the seed fixed and/or chain the last frame into the next shot
expectations.evidence: No mention of seed locking or last-frame chaining

expectations.text: Vertical or square framing is addressed, since the target is Instagram rather than 16:9
expectations.evidence: Recommends 9:16 in Flow and notes the crop-safe framing
